back_subject: A lot has changed in Komiks·Lab
back_intro: Hi %s! Your Norwegian is still waiting for you — and the app has grown since your last visit. New comics, new tests and a few things that simply work better now.
back_after: Ten minutes a day is enough to keep what you have learned.
news_intro: Hi %s! Here is a short list of what changed recently — new stories, tests and small improvements.
news_after: Everything works right away, nothing to install.
comic_subject: A new comic for you — Komiks·Lab
comic_intro: Hi %s! Here is a comic you have not read yet. Norwegian audio, translation on hover, and a quiz at the end.
comic_after: One story a day is a habit that holds.
magic_intro: Hi %s! Tap the button to sign in — no password needed. Or type the code below if you are on another device.
magic_after: The link and the code work for 15 minutes and only once. If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this email — nobody can get in without it.
verify_intro: Hi %s! Thanks for joining Komiks·Lab. Tap the button to confirm your email and activate your account.
verify_after: The link works for 48 hours. If you did not sign up, just ignore this email — nothing will happen.
welcome_intro:
Your email is confirmed and your account is ready. Here is how to start:
📖 read your first Norwegian comic with real voices,
🎨 create your hero in the avatar studio,
🏁 race friends in the Logic Race and collect badges.
welcome_after: Your progress is now saved in your account and follows you on every device.
reset_intro: Hi %s! Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password for your Komiks·Lab account.
reset_after: The link works for 1 hour. If it was not you, ignore this email — your password stays the same.
exists_subject: You already have a Komiks·Lab account
exists_intro: Hi %s! Someone tried to sign up with this email, but you already have an account.
exists_after: Forgot your password? Use “Forgot password” on the login page.
setpass_subject: An account was created for you — Komiks·Lab
setpass_intro: A free Komiks·Lab account has been created for you. Choose your own password and start learning Norwegian with comics.
setpass_after: The link works for 7 days. After that you can use “Forgot password” on the login page.
footer: You got this email because this address was used on Komiks·Lab — learn Norwegian with comics.
